entities.name: Muronia
entities.description: A blighted land on the eastern side of North Aerona succumbing to a mysterious corruption.

entities.name: Muronian Order
entities.description: A holy order whose missionary dervishes warn of the doom on the day of Ragalka.

entities.name: Garth One-Eye
entities.description: Used a Muronian dervish's habit and cowl to hide his identity.

entities.name: Gull
entities.description: Leader of an anti-wizard crusade that included three Muronian dervishes.

entities.name: Time of Troubles
entities.description: The period during which Garth disguised himself.

events.summary: During the Time of Troubles Garth One-Eye uses a Muronian dervish's habit and cowl to hide his identity.
events.quote: Garth One-Eye used a Muronian dervish's habit and cowl

events.summary: Three Muronian dervishes become part of Gull's anti-wizard crusade.
